newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: EU expects successful telecoms deal by Feb 97.
newsitem.headline: EU expects successful telecoms deal by Feb 97.

text.p: European Union (EU) Trade Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan said in a statement on Thursday he expected a successful conclusion to the World Trade Organisation's negotiations on a basic telecommunications agreement by February 1997.

Brittan said discussions at this week's ministerial meeting of the World Trade Organisation (WTO) in Singapore were an important milestone in the progress towards liberalising the world's telecommunications markets.

"As it stands of now, the Ministerial Declaration unequivocally states that we will achieve a successful conclusion to the negotiations on basic telecoms in February 1997," Brittan said in the statement, referring to the declaration to be issued at the end of the WTO conference on Friday.
"I welcome the significant number of new and improved offers announced in the course of this week. New offers have been announced by Barbados, Egypt, Jamaica and South Africa."
He said Indonesia had advised that it was seriously studying and considering making an offer.

"Australia, Canada, Hong Kong, Korea, Poland and Switzerland have advised that they will also improve their offers," the statement said. "I expect more new and improved offers will come forward and these would be welcome to ensure the success of the negotiations."
